title: Track installed guidance snippets and updates
description:
Design and implement a lightweight, reliable way for guidance-composer to determine:
- which guidance snippets are already installed
- whether any installed snippets need updating

Produce a proposal for principal approval before implementation.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Proposal documents the data model, detection algorithm, update semantics, and failure behavior.
2. Implementation begins only after proposal approval.
3. Installed snippets can be identified without expensive scanning or network dependence.
4. Changed source snippets are reported as needing update.
5. Tests cover installed, current, outdated, missing, and corrupted metadata cases.
notes:
Initial proposal was rejected because verbose per-ID/hash metadata would bloat the managed region.

Principal feedback verbatim: "I do NOT like this approach, it is going to heavily bloat the managed region, what about a bitmask?"

Follow-up requirement: design the smallest reliable bitmask-based representation. Explain why a bare installed mask is or is not sufficient for freshness, define stable catalog indexing/version semantics, migration and corruption behavior, and quantify managed-region bytes. Proposal only; do not implement.

title: Reduce Crew delegation and coordination overhead
description: Review representative local sessions, then revise Crew and model-routing guidance for direct Captain execution, deliberate workspace placement, bounded startup and recovery inspection, efficient result collection, appropriate Luna selection, and verified resource retirement. Keep private session evidence outside the repository.
acceptance_criteria: Captains can finish without Workers; workspace choice is independent of role and launcher; terminal screens are limited to startup bug diagnosis while worker-read remains available for recovery; message delivery and acceptance remain explicit; cleanup covers branches and worktrees; routing distinguishes model suitability from effort labels; relevant validation passes.
close_reason: Reconciled installed Crew capabilities with current branch policies. Traced feature commits and selected-file installation/direct-edit history. Rescued explicit launch argv and warnings, exact spec export, supported-principal validation, protocol pointers, and optional routing decision IDs; rejected conflicting old delegation, placement, reporting, and startup rules. Verification: 57 assignment tests, 40 subtests, 10 frontmatter tests, skill validation, effective seam resolution, and diff checks. Installed copies and other worktrees remain untouched.

title: Ship reliable account-aware Orca Crew launches
description: Spawn an astra high agent on the furankuskills repo and have it ship the fix, push and update our installation on this machine
acceptance_criteria: Preserve account identity, fresh quota and requested model/effort; repair native Orca launch contract with hermetic regressions; publish without rewriting history and update installed Crew/model-routing through supported installation.
close_reason: Published native account-aware Orca launch repair; complete repository tests passed and supported targeted installation verified against source, with unrelated work preserved.

title: Keep Commander assignments focused on outcomes and delegate solution design
description:
User request (verbatim):
Spawn an agent on furnaku skills to update whatever guidance is missing or exists that is causing commanders to take over design decisions.

User clarification (verbatim):
Commanders don’t think about the solution, they delegate the design to captains for large shit and to workers for smaller shit. You prescribed solutions and that’s NOT your responsibility.

Assignment: Diagnose actual furanku-skills instructions, distinguish missing guidance from noncompliance, correct Commander/Captain/Worker design ownership, run meaningful checks, commit locally, and prepare integration/install handoff. No UE-MMO changes or remote publication.
design: Diagnosis: Captain already owns design/implementation/verification/integration; Commander already delegates execution and verification. Missing instructions cover Commander-originated architecture/algorithm/acceptance mandates, follow-up design takeover, and bounded Worker design ownership. Existing role boundaries make parts of the reported incident noncompliance; no incident transcript was supplied or inspected, so this change establishes clearer guidance rather than proving the cause of that run. Correction stays in Commander and Worker role contracts; Captain and shared routing/lifecycle policy remain canonical and unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Commander/Captain/Worker role contracts preserve delegated solution ownership and sourced user requirements; accepted correction is integrated into local main; installed Crew matches integrated source through supported installation; unrelated main work and other installed skill records are preserved; Commander reload and safe resource-cleanup pointers are handed to root without remote publication.
notes: Continuation authorized the same Worker to perform local main integration and supported Crew installation. Local main fast-forwarded from 75aa6c7e8f0d8657caec3286b3fabe7b6c6444e2 to accepted correction bdbd16402c671966817362ee35af0a0706c2b003; pre-existing dirty and untracked main paths retained their original status and byte fingerprints. Supported Skills CLI installed only Crew from local main for Codex and Claude Code; all 10 installed source files match, Claude resolves to the canonical copy, and every other skill lock entry is unchanged. Installed Crew validation passed with the existing Python 3.13.1 interpreter after main selected a Python lacking PyYAML; no dependencies were installed or validators reimplemented. Earlier focused packet checks (11 tests and 7 subtests), frontmatter, source validation, and package preview remain applicable because their inputs are unchanged. Worker reloaded its installed contract; root received the exact installed Commander contract path and owns that live reload plus terminal/worktree/branch retirement. No remote push/publication or UE-MMO changes. Verification covers source, packaging, installation, and preservation; live-agent adherence remains unproven.
close_reason: Accepted correction integrated into local main and installed through supported CLI; installed source and unrelated-work preservation verified; Commander reload and cleanup pointers reported to root.
